title: ClassicalRawLisseRealizationData
statement: Fix a finite-field datum $D$, a prime $\ell\ne p$ [def-weil-finite-field-fiber], finite coefficient extensions and their valuation rings [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension], and separated finite-type $k$-schemes [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties]. The normalized raw classical realization datum consists of: the finite-free full subcategory of the classical integral systems [def-pod-lisse-l-adic-sheaves], their existing tensor-Hom scalar localization; an equivalence with finite locally free modules over the completed integral ring [def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients], pinned by ordinary scalar cokernels and inverse-limit projections, unit and counit equations; degree-zero inclusion with membership in the sf constructible integral category and the sf rational heart [def-weil-constructible-heart]; the inverse-limit/rationalization object and fraction formulas; full faithfulness; the normalized comparison to the prescribed lisse module realization [def-real-lisse-realization-data]; the identity-induced integral and rational sf/PBC equivalence [def-fd-coefficient-comparison-datum], comparison to continuous realization [def-per-continuous-rational-realization-data], and exact lifting of a specified module isomorphism; and the classical inverse-limit-stalk fibre comparison with sf and PBC adic fibres [def-a1-intrinsic-adic-fibre-specification]. These are comparison data with their defining equations; no existence is asserted. On every integral representative in the heart, the PBC-to-sf rational fibre comparison is the identity after the specified identity-induced integral coefficient transport; its component is heterogeneously equal to the identity of the actual sf completed integral fibre. The coefficient, category, site and realization interfaces used here are those of [def-real-lisse-realization-data], [def-per-continuous-rational-realization-data], [def-per-adic-base-stages], [def-weil-rationalization-karoubi], [def-fd-coefficient-comparison-datum], [def-weil-pbc-bounded-constructible-tower], [def-real-lisse-tensor-normalization], [def-a1-intrinsic-adic-fibre-specification], [def-sf-scalar-reduction-categories-restriction], [def-sf-completed-integral-scalar-action], [def-per-site-comparison-pullback-data], [def-weil-frobenius-point-transport], [def-weil-derived-complete-integral-detailed], [def-weil-pbc-rational-category], [def-weil-linear-scalar-localization], [prop-weil-pbc-rational-transport], [def-pur-completed-coefficient-presentation-transport], [def-per-lisse-completed-system-data]. The integral identity uses the actual coefficient transport of [def-sfb-integral-completed-coefficient-transport]. The PBC completed category and its finite-coefficient datum are those of [def-weil-pbc-bounded-constructible-complete].
